title.en: Muse Spark Open: Release of the Most Capable US Open-Weight Model

text.zh: Meta AI 今日发布 Muse Spark Open，这是迄今为止最强有力的美国开源权重模型。该模型为原生多模态架构，总参数 816B（激活参数 42B），上下文窗口达到 100 万令牌，专为编码和代理式工作打造。
text.en: Meta AI releases Muse Spark Open today, the most capable US open-weight model to date. A native multimodal architecture with 816B total parameters (42B active) and a 1M-token context window, it is purpose-built for coding and agentic workflows.

text.zh: 该模型首次实现完全在本地运行，支持苹果 M5 Ultra Mac Studio，使用 MLX 框架。双机配置下，统一内存架构让 512GB 显存与 1.2TB/s 带宽形成超级计算机级表现。
text.en: The model achieves its first fully on-device inference on Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios using the MLX framework. Two machines with unified memory architecture deliver supercomputer-level performance through up to 512 GB per studio and 1.2 TB/s bandwidth.

text.zh: 在真实代理工作流测试中，模型完成 iOS 客户端 Ice Cubes 的端到端开发，包括 bug 修复、新功能和完整构建；还驱动 DaVinci Resolve 的全流程剪辑，逐帧分析视频并自动裁剪垂直版本。
text.en: Real-world agentic workflows demonstrate the model: it shipped full iOS changes to Ice Cubes (an open-source Mastodon client) including bug fixes, new features, and a complete build, and end-to-end drove DaVinci Resolve with frame-by-frame footage review and vertical cropping.

text.zh: 模型通过 Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework 的多维度评估，在各类严重风险类别中达到发布门槛。开源权重版本额外添加了安全后训练措施。权重已于今日开放，可通过 Hugging Face、Amazon SageMaker AI 等平台下载。
text.en: The model meets the thresholds of the Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework across severe risk categories. The open-weight version includes additional safety post-training. Weights are available for download today via Hugging Face, Amazon SageMaker AI, Google Cloud Model Garden, and Microsoft Foundry Models.

text.zh: “我们相信未来属于所有人，包括在家运行先进模型的自由。”
text.en: “We believe the future is for everyone, and that includes the freedom to run advanced models wherever, including at home.”
